title: RFL Driver Interface — canonical messages
description: Canonical driver message payloads (03-driver-interface.md § Canonical driver messages): execute (action Goal), telemetry (action Feedback), status (action Result), and the clearance-query service (request / response). A message is exactly one of the five, discriminated by `message`. Representation types owned by other chapters (CanonicalAction / Pose6D by 02, Verdict by 01, ForceEvent / TactileFeature / the fidelity tier by 04) are carried, not redefined — floored here. Backs conformance test class 3 (driver-protocol compliance).

Identifier.description: An action correlation id, opaque and unique within a session; ties an execute goal to its telemetry feedback and status result.

Force.description: A force value (canonical wire unit N): a unit-suffixed quantity string (N / kN / mN). A realized wire value carries no let-reference (post-retarget).

Length.description: A length value (canonical wire unit m): a unit-suffixed quantity string (m / mm / cm).

Duration.description: A duration value (canonical wire unit s): a unit-suffixed quantity string (s / ms). A realized wire value carries no let-reference (post-execution measurement).

FidelityTier.description: The confirmation fidelity tier (04 § Fidelity tier and audit honesty): manifold > proxy > proxy_reactive.

TactileFeature.description: A TactileManifold feature (04 § Feature taxonomy): one of the eleven closed-core features, or an ext.<ns>.<name> registered extension feature (06). The closed core is fixed so the conformance suite can enumerate it; it is asserted identical to skill-isa's TactileFeature core (validate.py C4).

CanonicalActionFloor.description: The 02 CanonicalAction, carried verbatim (target_frame, target_pose:Pose6D, force_budget, timing, tactile_target, monitors, safety_envelope:Envelope). Its fields and their representation are owned by 02 / 01 / 04, so this is an open floor — the driver-interface schema does not re-encode a representation it does not own.

Pose6DFloor.description: A 02 Pose6D (position in R^3 + unit quaternion). Representation owned by 02; floored here.

WrenchFloor.description: A measured force / torque wrench. Representation owned by 02 / 04; floored here.

VerdictFloor.description: A 01 three-valued Verdict (true / false above confidence_threshold, else indeterminate) with evidence. Owned by 01; floored here.

ForceEventFloor.description: A 04 ForceEvent (kind / at / magnitude — breakaway or detent). Owned by 04; floored here.

ModelElement.description: A collision-model element designator (03 § Collision model): a named designator (target / region / against_surface / setdown_surface / support_object / a freed object) or a structured reference.

MovingSet.description: The body / bodies that sweep (03 § Collision model, Moving set): effector(frame) or effector_with_held(frame, grasp).

MotionQuery.description: The geometry swept (03 § Collision model, Motion query): at_pose / corridor / swept, all three mandatory of a driver. The geometry payload (a pose / a from-to pair / a trajectory or rotation) has its representation owned by 01 / 02 — floored.

ExecuteGoal.description: execute — the action Goal (RFL -> driver): delivers one canonical action.

TelemetryFeedback.description: telemetry — the action Feedback (driver -> RFL): a continuous sample stamped on the 04 manifold timebase, interval-sampled by the 05 envelope classes. Only message / action_id / t are mandatory; the rest are present per the executing primitive (a pure reach has no securing_force / wrench, a proxy-tier embodiment omits tactile).

t.description: Timestamp on the 04 common monotonic manifold timebase; multi-rate features align on the slowest-contributing-feature grid (04 TM16c).

station_error.description: Distance from the reach.hover station setpoint (01 § 1.5 'externally measured station error'); sampled by the interval-invariant settling check (05 ENV3).

tactile.description: Manifold feature readings (present only when tactile_sensing is declared). The feature key is checkable against the closed core; its reading representation is owned by 04, floored.

events.description: ForceEvents fired this sample (breakaway / detent, 04 § Force events).

StatusResult.description: status — the action Result (driver -> RFL): the terminal outcome, the ownership-split failure classification, and the 05 audit record. failure_class carries the protocol-level modes this chapter owns; failure_detail carries the primitive-specific 01 vocabulary token (form-constrained, not re-enumerated here).

outcome.description: The three-valued terminal verdict; indeterminate is never coerced to success or failure (01 three-valued control flow).

failure_class.description: A protocol-level failure mode defined in this chapter's own sections (capability_absent § Capability checking; no_collision_free_path / blocked § Collision model; out_of_range / region_underdetermined § Sensor descriptor; coordination_unavailable § Multi-embodiment addressing). Present iff outcome = failed and the cause is protocol-level.

failure_detail.description: The primitive-specific failure mode the executed primitive declares in 01 (e.g. jammed, grasp_lost, pose_not_reached), or an ext.<ns>.<name> extension mode. 01 owns the vocabulary, so the form is constrained but the modes are not enumerated here.

safety_flags.description: Safety-critical facts the audit record propagates (05 AUD2 / AUD3).

momentary_release.description: Set by a continuity-suspending operation (in_hand.flip), persisted and propagated downstream (05 AUD2).

freed_part_disposition.description: A freeing operation's disposition contract (04 § Freed-part handling): retained or safe_zone_release(zone), never an uncontrolled drop. The zone representation is owned by 04, floored.

stop_latency.description: Externally measured time from envelope breach to the at-rest safe state, bounded by embodiment.limits.stop_time (01 § 1.5 C2); present only on an aborted action. Read by check_settling.

ClearanceRequest.description: clearance-query request (03 § Collision model): a deterministic minimum-clearance query against the static model with the exempt / augment sets.

exempt.description: Static-model elements excluded as intended proximity.

augment.description: Extra obstacles added to the static model (the freed-object dual).

ClearanceResponse.description: clearance-query response (03 § Collision model): the minimum clearance over the motion and the feasibility result. Deterministic for identical inputs (X6c).

result.description: no_collision_free_path when the moving set cannot clear the model (self-collision or blocked), distinguishing tight-but-feasible from no-feasible-path.
